recommendation: Keep the source fix. It removes misleading current-spec wording in build-scope inputs while avoiding a speculative new STU warning whose historical request was never applied and whose accuracy after later R5/R6 identifier rewrites would need human or work-group confirmation.
issue_request: FHIR-25460 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for R5 and asked to clarify the Absence of Reliable Messaging documentation: say the section describes a protocol for infrastructure that does not guarantee reliable messaging, refer to sender/receiver implementation of this protocol, replace Bundle.id examples/table entries with Bundle.identifier, and add an STU feedback note.
initial_application: Git 5e623b7da8, merged by a30b9f6df8, applied the opening paragraph and sender wording in source/messaging.html but left the receiver wording unchanged. Later commits for the FHIR-39096 message-identifier family updated the table and examples to Bundle.identifier and added the current implementer note; no history showed the exact requested untested-protocol STU feedback note being applied.
additional_context: FHIR-25461 was the related identifier question and resolved no-change because other trackers addressed it. FHIR-29690 and FHIR-39096 established the current model in which Bundle.identifier, not Bundle.id or MessageHeader.id, identifies the message; FHIR-39096 is already represented on the combined branch. FHIR-46564 is a later Resolved-change-required asynchronous messaging clarification, so it was treated as context only in this default Applied/Published run.
reconciliation: Changed source/messaging.html so the receiver rule says 'When a receiver implements this protocol'. Changed both duplicated text surfaces in source/messageheader/operationdefinition-MessageHeader-process-message.xml so $process-message points to reliable-messaging rules for message Bundle.identifier values rather than stale Bundle.id/message-id wording.
source_changes: source/messaging.html: changed the receiver rule from 'When a receiver implements reliable messaging' to 'When a receiver implements this protocol'.

source/messageheader/operationdefinition-MessageHeader-process-message.xml: changed the $process-message footer and comment link text from rules for 'Bundle.id and message id' to rules for message Bundle.identifier values.
